prompt:
A TALL VERTICAL PORTRAIT, exactly 2:3 (ten wide by fifteen tall) — much taller than it is wide, the shape of a phone game screen. NOT landscape, NOT square.

The wilderness of Sinai in the last hour before dawn, seen from standing height. The top two-fifths of the frame is a deep violet-indigo night sky with a scatter of small fading stars and a faint warm glow low on the horizon. THE HORIZON LINE MUST SIT ABOUT TWO-FIFTHS OF THE WAY DOWN THE FRAME, and everything below it is open desert sand running to the bottom edge — warm clay and honey tones, soft dune shading, catching the first warm light from the sky.

THE SAND MUST BE COMPLETELY BARE. No manna, no flakes, no seeds, no white specks, no dew, no people, no animals, no tents, no camps, no fires, no footprints, no tracks, no plants, no scrub, no rocks, no stones, no ruins, no path, no objects of any kind resting on the ground. Nothing whatsoever stands, lies or sits on the sand. Things are drawn on top of this painting, so anything painted onto that ground will be drawn over.

Warm hand-illustrated storybook style with clean flat shapes and soft painted shading — no photorealism, no line art, no text, no lettering, no watermark, no border, no frame, no vignette. Values kept soft and mid-toned across the sand so small pale objects placed on it stay clearly readable.

REMEMBER: a 2:3 upright frame, the horizon two-fifths down, and completely bare ground below it.

A TALL VERTICAL PORTRAIT, exactly 2:3 (ten wide by fifteen tall) — much taller than it is wide, the shape of a phone game screen. NOT landscape, NOT square.

ONE BLANK PAGE of old cream Bible paper, seen flat and straight on, filling the frame corner to corner with no surface, desk or background visible around it. Soft laid-paper fibre grain, a faint warm foxing toward the corners, a gentle shadow along the very LEFT edge where the page turns into the binding, and the softest lift of light through the middle.

ABSOLUTELY NOTHING IS PRINTED ON IT. No text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no verse numbers, no page number, no ruled lines, no margin rules, no columns, no drawings, no illumination, no ornament, no border, no frame, no watermark, no signature. The page is entirely blank — words are drawn on top of this painting.

Warm hand-illustrated storybook style with clean flat shapes and soft painted shading, no photorealism, no line art. Warm cream and honey paper against soft violet-brown shadow, light and even enough across the whole page that dark ink laid over it stays easy to read.

REMEMBER: a 2:3 upright frame, edge-to-edge blank paper, and NOT ONE MARK on it.

A SQUARE FRAME, 1:1. A carpenter's workshop wall at night, seen straight on from a step away: rough vertical timber boarding, warm lamplight falling from the upper left, deep violet-brown shadow gathering at the corners and along the bottom.

THE WHOLE MIDDLE OF THE FRAME MUST BE EMPTY, PLAIN AND DARK — bare boards only across the centre two-thirds, with nothing hanging on them and nothing standing in front of them. A few small carpenter's things may sit FAR OUT at the left and right edges only, half in shadow: a hand plane on a peg, a coil of cord, a mallet. Nothing in the middle. An object is drawn over the centre of this painting, so anything painted there will be covered.

NO CROSS of any kind, no crossed timbers, no beams laid across each other, no religious symbol, no signage, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no watermark, no people, no hands, no animals, no window, no bright lamp in frame.

Warm hand-illustrated storybook style with clean flat shapes and soft painted shading, no photorealism, no line art. Deep, quiet and low-contrast — this is a backdrop that has to sit behind pale letters, so keep it dim and let nothing in it compete with what stands in front of it.

REMEMBER: a square frame, dim timber boarding, the centre completely bare, and no cross anywhere in the image.
